Messages.Body:
Ok here's another one. Read Intentions says at the superior version(I think it might be at normal) that the vampire gains a dodge. This is listed as a straight dodge not a Strike:Dodge if this is true then can I play my Strike:Steal Blood right after I dodged? All the other dodge cards say Strike:Dodge exa. Acrobatics, Dodge, etc. What's the ruling here????

Jason Bishop

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
All dodges are considered strikes, even if the card forgets to say so.
